limitations: GPU nonzero-util sample counts and utilization-weighted seconds are one-second NVML estimates, not exact kernel execution or SM occupancy.
Process CPU and I/O totals are lower bounds: processes exiting between samples are missed.

Stage 3 to Stage 4 independently measures build/model load. This runtime performs its one-step warmup after Stage 4 starts, within generate(). Its exact subwindow is only source-log-timestamped, not monotonic-instrumented.
Source-reported runtime stage durations are labeled separately and are not substituted for independent event windows.

Remote monotonic timestamps are comparable only within the remote host. Never subtract them from local-host Codex/broker monotonic timestamps; cross-host UTC is only a join key with unmeasured clock-sync error.

NVML compute-app PIDs on this node can be host-namespace IDs absent from the visible /proc namespace. GPU jobs are attributed by UUID, run event, and exclusive allocation; process CPU uses visible run-command ancestry only. Do not directly join an unmatched NVML PID to /proc CPU.

When candidate runs overlap on different UUIDs, a run window's eight-GPU node context includes the other run's activity. Only per-job UUID assignments and summed allocated_gpu_s belong to a particular run.
